_comment: Release gate A15: every appliance type a source knows is in the catalogue or excluded with a reason. Home Connect devices are handled by their type, so the catalogue is the list of types (kept equal to src/lib/device-catalog.ts by device-catalog.test.ts).

excluded.Cooktop: Home Connect reports hobs with the type Hob, not Cooktop (Home Assistant PR #182039, 2026-09-12) - the adapter knows the type as Hob.
